items: The script defines one value named club.
Vue evaluates `{{ club }}` inside the heading and inserts its text.

blocks.text: The page shows Garden club as its heading.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use curly brackets for text values. Do not put raw user strings into v-html.
